dateBasis: arXiv first submission date (UTC), one count per arXiv ID; revisions are not new papers
scope: Curated, non-exhaustive diffusion/flow depth-recurrence sample including implicit fixed-point denoisers, visual, language and audio models. One-step distilled generators GET and Depth as Time are adjacent, excluded from direct Loop Diffusion counts. Historical and newly added records checked against original arXiv abstracts and v1 submission dates.

papers.name: GET
papers.title: One-Step Diffusion Distillation via Deep Equilibrium Models
papers.evidence: Original abstract: Generative Equilibrium Transformer distilled from diffusion; one-step generator, kept adjacent consistently with Depth as Time.

papers.name: FPDM
papers.title: Fixed Point Diffusion Models
papers.evidence: Original abstract: implicit fixed-point layer inside diffusion denoising network; variable inner computation across timesteps; abstract-level review.

papers.name: ELT
papers.title: ELT: Elastic Looped Transformers for Visual Generation
papers.evidence: Original paper §4 describes ILSD; §5.2 and Table 2 explicitly evaluate DiT; main results also cover masked visual generation.

papers.name: The Thinking Pixel
papers.title: The Thinking Pixel: Recursive Sparse Reasoning in Multimodal Diffusion Latents
papers.evidence: Original abstract: recursive sparse modules inside joint-attention layers, refining visual tokens with parameter sharing; abstract-level review.

papers.name: LoopMDM
papers.title: Looped Diffusion Language Models
papers.evidence: Original abstract: selectively loop early-middle Transformer layers in masked diffusion language models; abstract-level review.

papers.name: R-MDM
papers.title: Recursive Scaling in Masked Diffusion Models
papers.evidence: Original abstract: repeat the shared denoising Transformer within each masked diffusion step; v2 is a revision, not a September first release; abstract-level review.

papers.name: Hidden-State Refinement
papers.title: Training-Free Hidden-State Refinement for Flow-Matching Image Generators
papers.summary: 冻结生成器的内部循环
papers.evidence: Original abstract: repeatedly applies selected Transformer layers inside a frozen flow-matching denoiser, preserving outer sampler; abstract-level review.

papers.name: Recurrent TTS
papers.title: Depth through recurrence: Looped transformers for flow-matching TTS
papers.summary: 语音生成中的深度共享
papers.evidence: Original abstract and v1 submission history; shared Transformer layouts inside flow-matching TTS; abstract-level review.

papers.name: Depth as Time
papers.title: Depth as Time in One-Step Generative Models
papers.evidence: Original paper §5 and Appendix C.1 distill a one-step MeanFlow teacher into shared blocks. Kept separate from direct looped diffusion counts.

papers.name: ALoDLM
papers.title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: 逐 token 自适应循环
papers.evidence: Original abstract: token-adaptive latent recurrence within each masked diffusion step; abstract-level review.

papers.name: LiFT
papers.title: LiFT: Loop Flow Transformers
papers.evidence: Original paper §3, §4.4 and Appendix A.3 Table 6; main presentation case.

papers.name: LoopREG
papers.title: LoopREG: Representation Supervision Enables Test-Time Recurrent Depth in Diffusion Transformers
papers.evidence: Original paper §3–4, Table 1 and site interventions: endpoint representation alignment, recurrent-depth extrapolation and the accompanying recall trade-off; selective reading.
